name: Basic Ads
description: Provides ad management with placements, scheduling, weighted rotation, display blocks, and impression/click tracking.
project_description: Basic Ads provides lightweight advertisement management for Drupal built entirely on core node/taxonomy/views. On install it creates a 'Basic Ad' content type (image + link + placement + start/end date + weight fields), a 'Basic Ad Placement' taxonomy vocabulary with default terms (Header, Sidebar, Footer, Content Top, Content Bottom), a 'Basic Ads' View, and two custom database tables for impression and click tracking. Ads are shown via the 'Basic Ad block (by placement)' block, which emits a cacheable placeholder and loads the actual ad client-side from an uncacheable /ad/fragment endpoint so the host page stays fully cached while ads rotate per view. Selection uses weighted random sampling (Efraimidis-Spirakis) driven by each ad's weight field. Impressions are tracked client-side, clicks server-side through a redirect endpoint; IP addresses are anonymized and tracking data older than one year is pruned via cron. Cron also unpublishes expired ads. A statistics dashboard reports impressions, clicks, and CTR overall and by placement. Configured roles can be excluded from tracking.
